faq.q: What is a titanium foldable phone hinge?
faq.a: A titanium foldable phone hinge is a precision-machined phone hardware component used in foldable device micro-mechanical screen hinge (beta-ti). Manufactured from Grade 5 Ti-6Al-4V for optimal strength, corrosion resistance, and weight savings.

faq.q: How is the surface finish achieved on titanium foldable phone hinge?
faq.a: Titanium Foldable Phone Hinge receives PVD coating (ISO 27874, Delta-E <=1.0 color accuracy) for wear resistance and aesthetics, plus oleophobic AFP nano-coating (water contact angle >110 deg) to resist fingerprints and skin oils.

faq.q: What CNC equipment is used for titanium foldable phone hinge?
faq.a: Titanium Foldable Phone Hinge is machined on 5-axis CNC equipment with high-pressure coolant (1000 psi) to manage titanium's low thermal conductivity and work-hardening tendency. Tolerances of +-0.01mm are standard.

faq.q: What is the most common issue with titanium foldable phone hinge?
faq.a: The most common issue is surface contamination from iron pickup during machining requiring acid passivation (astm f86). Mitigation includes proper process control, material certification, and adherence to recommended installation procedures and torque values.

faq.q: What is the lead time for titanium foldable phone hinge?
faq.a: Standard lead time: 2-4 weeks depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders available. Contact our team with your drawing and quantity for an accurate delivery quote.
